chapter_rule: ONE chapter-qualified rule total (A.0 end-seal, p3c51): body[data-chapter='p3c51'] .chapter-text>p:last-child::after{content:url("data:image/svg+xml,...gs-b-spark 26px gold...");display:inline-block;width:26px;height:26px;margin-left:.6em;vertical-align:-4px} — flat spark, ≤32px, no layout shift. Zero landmark rules (B has no landmarks).
guards: 560px: banner svg max-height 34vh (prototype value); motif max-width 20rem; spark seal 22px; TOC discs 10px; meta-title clamp handles.
print: banner/motif svg max-height 3.2in centered; spark seal prints; TOC/progress/nav hidden by shared; no ink washes (none authored).
reduced-motion: .banner,.motif{animation:none} (the §9 rise), content visible (both = animation fill both, cut = visible).
phone overflow (GR3): banner svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:100%} + figure{overflow-x:clip} + motif svg same; zero vw units in cohort CSS; validator probes scrollWidth<=390.
part_systems: C1 OPENER GEOMETRY: P #chapter-art.banner{width:100vw;max-width:100vw;margin:0 calc(50% - 50vw) 2.4rem;background:#04161d} P #chapter-art.banner svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:46vh} P #chapter-art.motif{max-width:24rem;margin:0 auto 2rem} P #chapter-art.motif svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto} (prototype values verbatim; vw-bleed is supervisor/prototype grammar, kept; GR3 contained via guards).

C2 TYPE (§3): P .meta-part{font-family:var(--gs-display);letter-spacing:.28em;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--gs-sun);margin:0 0 1rem} P .meta-title{font-family:var(--gs-display);font-weight:560;font-variation-settings:'SOFT' 100,'WONK' 1;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,6vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance} P .chapter-text{font-family:var(--gs-body)} P .chapter-text p{max-width:68ch} — uniform titles (no italic/gold/size landmarks).
C3 META-RULE: P .meta-rule span{width:4rem;height:3px;border-radius:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gs-sun),var(--gs-vermilion));opacity:.9} (prototype rule; keeps art.css glow).

C4 PROGRESS (§8): P .progress-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gs-sun),var(--gs-vermilion))} + sun-disc leading edge: P .progress-fill{position:relative} P .progress-fill::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-4px;top:50%;translate:0 -50%;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gs-sun);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--gs-sun)} — 8px disc is chrome geometry, not art; ::after on fill is free (art.css owns meta/text pseudos, not progress).

C5 NAV (§8): P .nav-btn{border-radius:0;border-top:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--gs-sun) 40%,transparent)} P .nav-btn:hover:not(:disabled){border-top-color:var(--gs-sun);background:var(--surface);transform:none} P .nav-label{font-family:var(--gs-display);letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--gs-sun)} P .nav-title{font-family:var(--gs-display);font-style:normal} — horizon tablets, no lift.

C6 HEADER (§8): P .header-part{font-family:var(--gs-display);letter-spacing:.28em;color:var(--gs-sun)} P .header-chapter{font-family:var(--gs-display);font-weight:560} P .reader-header.scrolled{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--gs-sun) 25%,transparent)}

C7 SETTINGS (§8): P .settings-card{border-top:2px solid var(--gs-sun);border-radius:0} P #settings-title{font-family:var(--gs-display);font-style:italic} P .seg-btn.active{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--gs-sun) 45%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--gs-sun) 14%,transparent)}

C8 SEED SPARK (p3c51 shape, extendable): body[data-chapter='p3c51'] .chapter-text{position:relative;padding-left:2.2rem} body[data-chapter='p3c51'] .chapter-text::before{content:url("data:image/svg+xml,...gs-b-spark...");position:absolute;left:0;top:.45rem;width:26px;height:26px} — marginal spark floats left of first line (prototype .seal hand, adapted: reader owns

layout so spark hangs in padding, not flex). ::before on #chapter-text is free (art.css owns p::after + p:first-letter only). NO slot fill, NO runtime entry for p3c51.

C9 MOTION (§9): @media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){P #chapter-art.banner{animation:gsb-rise .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}P #chapter-art.motif{animation:gsb-rise .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}@keyframes gsb-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}} — one orchestrated rise; prototype banner-fade conformed to rise.
rule_counts: Part: C1-C9 (9 blocks, P-twins). Chapter: 1 (p3c51 A.0 seal + C8 pairs it). Landmark rules: 0. Supervisor-merge blocks: T (TOC, book-wide) + G (gull marginalia note). No new art pseudos; no animations beyond §9 rise; no radius/shadow cards.
supervisor_merge_TOC: SUPERVISOR-MERGE (book-wide, NOT cohort-b.css — TOC drawer serves all 8 parts; cohort file must not own it): .toc-part-header{border-top:1px solid var(--gs-horizon);position:relative} + altitude discs via .toc-part:nth-of-type(N) .toc-part-header::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-6px;left:calc(12% + N*10%);width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gs-sun)} with per-part positions: I below-line glow (top:2px,opacity .5), III climbing (left:34%), V zenith (centered, 13px + vermilion ring), VIII half-sunk red disc (background:var(--gs-vermilion);top:-3px). Landmark .toc-num gold: 7 rules keyed by [data-chapter-id='p1c1'|'p5c18'|'p6c66'|'p6c67'|'p7c1'|'p7c41'|'p8c1'] (zero modulo). Read spark: .toc-chapter.read .toc-check{background:var(--gs-sun);border-color:var(--gs-sun)} Active: .toc-chapter.active{box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--gs-vermilion)}. My v1 B5/B6 withdrawn (wrong scope: chapter-conditional TOC + non-§8 treatments).
